# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, young woman with fair, curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears very large sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is a sympathetic, bright, and ladylike woman with a sweet voice. She possesses a happy gift for winning the affection of her pupils and bringing out their best mental and moral qualities. She is tactful and broadminded, leading her students to explore and discover things for themselves rather than strictly adhering to old beaten paths.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P11](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0011), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Stacy was hired as the new lady teacher for Avonlea school, replacing Mr. Phillips. Upon taking her position in the autumn, she quickly introduced new educational methods, including physical culture exercises, field afternoons in the woods to study nature, and Friday afternoon recitations. In November, she organized a student concert on Christmas Night to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag. Later, she formed an advanced class to prepare her students for the Entrance examination to Queen's Academy, giving them extra lessons for an hour after school. Although offered a position in her home district, she chose to stay in Avonlea to see her students through their examinations. After seeing them successfully through, she later married and moved to California.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v3 c3 P16](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0016)_
